## About
The One Auto Service and Performance is a full repair shop at 536 Lisbon St in Daly City. We take care of foreign and domestic vehicles, from Audi, BMW and Porsche to Honda, Toyota, Ford and Jeep.
Along with everyday repairs, we install aftermarket performance parts like lowering springs, coilovers, intakes and exhaust. We keep a clean working area, and there's a waiting room with television and free wifi while you wait.
Drivers have rated us 4.2 from 55 Google reviews. Give us a call or send a quote request online anytime.

## Services
- Brake jobs, timing belts and engine replacement: From a brake job to a timing belt or a full engine replacement, we handle the big jobs and the small ones.
- Smog check: Smog check with the certificate included. Prices are subject to change. ($75 including certificate)
- Check engine light diagnostic: We look into the warning light and tell you what we find.
- Full vehicle inspection before purchase: Thinking about buying a car? We'll give it a full inspection first. One customer said we sent clear photos of every blemish and measured tire tread and brake life.
- Aftermarket performance parts: Installation of parts like lowering springs, coilovers, camber kits, intakes, headers and exhaust.

## FAQ
Q: What kinds of cars do you work on?
A: Foreign and domestic vehicles, including Porsche, Mercedes Benz, Land Rover, Jaguar, Lotus and Volvo.

Q: Can I get a quote online?
A: Yes. Online quotes are welcome, or you can call or email us anytime.

Q: How much will my repair cost?
A: Prices vary from vehicle to vehicle, so give us a call for an estimate.

## What customers say
- "We were looking to buy a car remotely from a local dealership, and asked The One Auto Service to do a pre-inspection for us.  Most other local mechanics wanted $120-$180 (3x the national average), and many weren't available.  The One Auto Service was the only place that offered a reasonable price of $80, and was willing to do it same-day for us.  We really appreciated that.

What we got back from them was fantastic.  They didn't find much in the way of mechanical problems, as the car did only have 13k miles.  But there were a number of paint defects (blemishes, scratches, etc) and The One emailed excellent high resolution, in-focus (which is somehow a rarity these days) photos of each and every blemish, from an angle and with lighting that showed it clearly so that we could make an informed decision.  We also got quantified measurements (not just "looks good") of each tire's tread and brake life.

In the end we decided to purchase a different car from another state, in excellent condition.  The One Auto Service helped save us from an unhappy purchase that we would have been reminded of every time we looked at our car for years.  I highly recommend them, and am glad there are competent businesses that can do their job well and don't need babysat to get it done.

Thank you The One!" (Nicholas Bostaph, 5/5)

They gave me confidence to continue on the rest of my drive and everything they said checked out later when I had a chance to do more research." (Genee Lee, 5/5)
